title: Can significance screening find an effect modifier at the strengths where omitting it biases the transported effect?
question: At source-trial sizes typical of appraisals, does interaction screening detect an effect modifier reliably wherever omitting it would bias the target-population effect, and is balancing or adjusting for every candidate a workable alternative when there are 6 or 13 candidates?
design: Continuous-outcome source trial with 6 or 13 candidate covariates and one true modifier at five strengths, targets shifted by 0.2 or 0.5 SD on every candidate; interactions screened at p < 0.05, MAIC balancing the true, screened or full set, and STC with all interactions. 20 cells, 1000 replicates each.
